kept.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: 3^5 ÷ 3^2 = 3^(5-2) = 3^3 = 27.
kept.pidgin: Wen you dey divide power wey get same base, you go minus di powers: 3^5 ÷ 3^2 = 3^3 = 27.

kept.explanation: log_2(32) means 2 raised to what power gives 32. Since 2^5 = 32, log_2(32) = 5.
kept.pidgin: log_2(32) mean say wetin 2 go power give 32. Since 2^5 = 32, answer na 5.

kept.explanation: 16^(3/4) means take the 4th root of 16 first, then cube it: 16^(1/4) = 2, so 2^3 = 8.
kept.pidgin: 16^(3/4) mean make you find di 4th root of 16 first, den cube am: 16^(1/4) = 2, so 2^3 = 8.

kept.explanation: Write 32 as a power of 2: 32 = 2^5. So 2^(x+1) = 2^5 means x+1 = 5, giving x = 4.
kept.pidgin: Write 32 as power of 2: 32 = 2^5. So 2^(x+1) = 2^5 mean say x+1 = 5, so x = 4.

kept.q: If log_x(81) = 4, find the value of x.
kept.pidgin: log_x(81) = 4 mean say x^4 = 81. Since 3^4 = 81, x = 3.
